About
Recipe
A recipe is a file you keep beside your tests. The same recipe and the same seed produce the same data on every machine.

Your recipe

version: "0.1"
seed: "readme"
locale: en-US
entities:
  customer:
    count: 1000
    primary_key: ssn
    fields:
      first_name: { generator: first_name, required:
true }
      last_name:  { generator: last_name, required:
true, max_length: 30 }
      gender:     { generator: gender }
      birth_date: { generator: birth_date }
      ssn:        { generator: ssn, unique: true }
      city:       { generator: city }
      state:      { generator: region }
      zip:        { generator: postal_code }
      plan:       { values: [free, pro, team] }
    consistency:
      - first_name matches: [gender]
  payment:
    belongs_to: { customer: 0-5 }
    fields:
      card: { generator: card }
output:
  format: csv
  dir: ./data
policy:
  layers: [L2, L3, REV]
  rows: 5%
Tab indents by two spaces. Ctrl+Space shows what can be written. Esc, then Tab,
leaves the field.
